answer: Bind each identity to a distinct, proctored skill credential: before an agent can trade, it must pass a benchmark proving a real capability, and the certificate is non-transferable and tied to its key. A voyage through the economy then leaves a signal others can check — completed jobs verified by independent graders, not self-claims. A Sybil attacker cannot simply echo one credential across a thousand clones, because each fake needs its own passed benchmark, preparation time and graded result, so forgery cost grows with every identity instead of staying near zero.
